headline: Yandex Cloud suffers third data center outage in recent weeks
summary: The cloud provider is experiencing ongoing issues, with a third data center reported to be affected.
details: Yandex Cloud has confirmed that a third of its data centers has been impacted by an outage.
This marks the third incident affecting the cloud provider's infrastructure in recent weeks, raising concerns about its stability and reliability.
Details regarding the cause and extent of the outage have not yet been fully disclosed by Yandex Cloud.
The company has stated it is working to restore services as quickly as possible.

topic: cloudflare bot traffic drops after yandex attack
headline_marked: [[Cloudflare bot traffic drops]] after Yandex datacenter strike
headline: Cloudflare bot traffic drops after Yandex datacenter strike
summary: A significant decrease in bot traffic has been observed on Cloudflare following a reported strike on a Yandex datacenter. The full impact is still being assessed.
details: Cloudflare has noted a sudden and substantial drop in bot traffic, a phenomenon that began shortly after reports emerged of a strike targeting a Yandex datacenter.
The exact nature and scale of the strike, as well as its direct causal link to the traffic reduction, are still under investigation. Yandex has not yet released an official statement.

This event highlights the interconnectedness of internet infrastructure and the potential for disruptions in one region or service to have widespread, albeit sometimes indirect, effects on global traffic patterns.
